literal_meaning: pushing or kicking with the feet
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাতে আসা সুযোগটি পায়ে ঠেলে দিল।
এই অবজ্ঞায় সবাই তার প্রতি ক্রুদ্ধ হয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: He kicked away the opportunity that came his way.
Everyone got angry at his display of contempt.
note: The idiom evokes the image of carelessly pushing something away with one's foot, symbolizing disregard for valuable things.
